rationale.hitl-workflow: Requires genuine intervention, override, reversal, and safe-stop authority.
rationale.oversight-explanation: System understanding and interpretable outputs establish necessary epistemic access.
rationale.automation-bias: Focally analyzes capable overseers becoming complacent and insufficiently vigilant.
rationale.oversight-theater: Mere observation, pseudo-options, and ignored interventions make oversight ineffective.
rationale.org-governance: Job design, accountability, roles, training, and environment condition effectiveness.
rationale.regulatory-compliance: Tests its oversight conditions extensively against EU AI Act Article 14.
rationale.intro-framing: Defines effective oversight conceptually without operationalizing a buildable mechanism.
rationale.counterpoint: Opposes both wholesale oversight dismissal and uncritical regulatory reliance.
rationale.general-ai: Addresses high-risk AI systems broadly, not AI-generated code.
rationale.risk-overreliance: Substantively analyzes automation bias, complacency, trust, and over-reliance.
